method.candidates: Tetris candidates are the test runs of its validated Pareto set (p135, selected on unpadded validation HOTA); they are re-ranked here, not re-selected
method.changes: rule shared_bound: bound_hota and hota_minus_bound use the unrounded bound (reference HOTA x (1 - loss), or LEAP's best HOTA), cached then padded; rule accuracy_matched: per bound the matched range, per dataset the pairing, with both sides' HOTA
method.clip_alignment: for datasets with a lengthened clip, per clip the mean over ground-truth boxes on frames 1..frame_count-2 of the best IoU with the reference's boxes on frame f-1, f, f+1 (0 without overlap), and the medians over the other clips; reference_t is the reference file's length
method.clip_length: n = max(polyis.utilities.get_video_frame_count (the frames the systems decode, as p140; checked to add up to the tradeoff frame_count), ground-truth file length); clips_lengthened lists where the ground truth is longer; scores do not depend on padding past both files, whose frames are empty on both sides
method.hota: means over the 19 alphas (HOTA_HOTA of p130/p142); TP/FN/FP at alpha 0.05
method.inputs: common.system_configs test-split configurations; common.output_path files; DATASET.json of p110/p141
method.mechanism: polyis/trackeval/dataset.py: num_timesteps = largest frame_idx + 1 per file (l.58-67), lists built to that length (l.76); TrackEval _base_dataset.get_raw_seq_data keeps the ground truth's num_timesteps (l.94) and zips similarities (l.98); HOTA (hota.py l.53, l.72), CLEAR (clear.py l.68), Identity (identity.py l.53) iterate zip(gt_ids, tracker_ids); Count and num_*_dets (dataset.py l.158-159) count every box; a side with no box takes the metrics' early exit (all FN or all FP)
method.padded: both sides copied to a temporary directory with an empty row on frame n - 1 where they end earlier; common.trackeval_rerun (TrackEval HOTA with polyis.trackeval.dataset.Dataset as p110/p141); every configuration re-scored; checked: TP + FN = GT_Dets, TP + FP = Dets, unchanged HOTA where nothing was unscored
method.reproduction: unpadded TrackEval rerun of the cached operating points of both rules and the reference must match DATASET.json
method.rounding: 4 decimals when written, changes 8; fps and speedups as common.operating_points rounds them (0.1 fps, 0.1x)
method.scorers: p110 (reference, Tetris: 002_naive, 060_uncompressed_tracks) and p141 (OTIF, LEAP: SOTA tracking_results) against the root dataset's 003_groundtruth, HOTA metric only, skip 1
method.selection: bounds from common.bound_specs (losses [0.05, 0.1] of the reference HOTA, and leap_fit = LEAP's best HOTA) on cached and on padded HOTA; shared_bound: common.operating_points (systems ['tetris', 'otif', 'leap']); accuracy_matched: p203's rule (common.accuracy_matched, as r7o1_hota_matched_speedup checks it against p203); fps from the tradeoff tables
method.speedup_ranges: Tetris over the reference where it meets the bound, over a prior system where both meet it, and over its accuracy-matched prior point where it has one
method.window: a clip is truncated when both files have boxes; unscored = ground-truth boxes on frames >= t_tracker and tracker boxes on frames >= t_gt, t = largest frame_idx + 1; rows unscored = frames between the two lengths, box frames = those with a box; *_past_frame_count = ground-truth boxes on frames >= frame_count, past every system's decoded frames; checked to the box against DATASET.json Count - TP - FN/FP (common.unscored_boxes)
